instruction: GUI-only requirement: Complete the task entirely in the Altium Designer graphical user interface. Do not open Command Prompt, PowerShell, Terminal, or any shell; do not run OutJob/script automation, IPC scripts, Python, or other helper scripts/code that directly generates or edits the deliverable files. Use only Altium Designer native GUI tools, menus, dialogs, and built-in save/export commands. The opened file `broken_spiritlevel_top.SchDoc` is a native Altium schematic. Repair the broken sheet-symbol target filenames, and save the repaired document as `C:\Users\user\Desktop\spiritlevel_top.SchDoc`.
